verdict.rationale: The official developer portal announces an Anytype CLI that runs Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting [anytype-docs-2]. That directly answers the story. The agents skill lets agent-capable CLI tools run scripts against Anytype data [anytype-docs-5, anytype-docs-37], which supports the AI-native workflow but is not the CLI itself. Missing for 10: CLI command reference or usage docs, installation details, how the CLI relates to the local API and MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
